title: TimerDisplay Mod
description: TimerDisplay shows a timer in the action bar and lets you control it with /timer start, /timer stop, and /timer reset.
body:
TimerDisplay adds a simple and clean timer to your action bar that runs completely client-side. It lets you track time while playing without opening any menus or overlays, and updates in real time.

You can control it easily with commands: /timer start starts the timer, /timer stop pauses it, and /timer reset resets it back to zero.

The mod is lightweight, fast, and designed for smooth performance, making it useful for speedruns, PvP, events, or general gameplay tracking.
